source: SPM 2026 Trial – Sarawak (Set 1) – English Paper 2 · Part 2 · Question 2 · Essay (125–150 words)
paragraphs: Travelling broadens our minds and creates memories that last a lifetime. A place I dream of visiting is Kyoto, Japan. This ancient city is famous for its tranquil temples, traditional wooden houses and breathtaking cherry blossoms.

First and foremost, I chose Kyoto because I want to immerse myself in Japanese culture. I hope to experience a traditional tea ceremony and stroll through historic streets. Furthermore, I am fascinated by its harmony of old and new. Ancient shrines stand side by side with modern cafés, which makes the city truly unique.

To encourage people to travel more in their own country, the government can offer attractive travel vouchers. This would make local holidays more affordable for families. Moreover, hidden gems such as Bako National Park should be promoted on social media. Eye-catching videos can spark the public's interest in exploring Malaysia.
